title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Alice Brandeis Gilbert '49 Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Kemeyawi Q. Wahpepah (Kickapoo, Sac and Fox) is a doctoral candidate in education at Harvard University whose research explores how settler colonialism is reproduced and resisted in United States schools. At Radcliffe, she will complete her dissertation, which centers the “schooling stories” of 45 Native and Indigenous students, exploring how they make meaning out of their experiences with curriculum, campus community, and commemoration from kindergarten through college.
